description.en:
Brings several characters, one after the other, back into the party with the return presentation. For each character, the jingle J_08 plays, the system message "sysmes-back_party" is shown with the character's name filled in (CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA), then the character is added with AddParty. The next character waits until the jingle has finished.
The current BGM is first stopped with a fade of 30 (CMND_SND_STOP); the function waits until it has stopped, then waits 30 more frames. Once everyone is added, the BGM starts again with the same fade.
It is a preset of AddParty_MessageEx(_add_num, _aParamID, _aPtLock, _aAvatarEnable, _aAvatarLock, _aLv, 30, 30, "J_08", 0, "sysmes-back_party").
Number of characters to add; the arrays below are read from index 0 to _add_num - 1.
Parameter IDs of the characters, e.g. ["para_cp0001", "para_cp0013"].
One level per character; -1 (or any value of 0 or less) keeps the current level.
